stolen-card.title: stolen card
stolen-card.summary: Aoife's card was taken from her bag on the bus. Tellerline verifies her, freezes the card and orders a replacement.

found-card.title: found it
found-card.summary: Niamh blocks her card while she looks for it, turns down a replacement, then finds it and has the block lifted.

dispute.title: dispute
dispute.summary: Róisín disputes a taxi fare she doesn't recognise. She pauses after the amount, and Tellerline drops the question it was about to ask and answers the whole sentence.

balance.title: balance
balance.summary: Cian checks his current account and hears his last three payments.
